checkpoint.changesSince2026-10-19: Evidence clarifications (owner's questions, 20 October 2026): slide 04 gains a three-tile strip with the Nitti severity bands BAUS uses (mild under 100 g, moderate 100 to 400 g, severe over 400 g in 24 hours); slide 06's BAUS bullet now states the two routes (VUDS for every candidate with cystoscopy only when a narrowing is suspected; standard UDS plus cystoscopy where video is unavailable). Script, cue cards and study lines add the MASTER further-surgery breakdown at twelve months, the Claims-Based Frailty Index explanation, the simplified MASTER caveat and the reason not to dilate during a diagnostic cystoscopy; see the 20 October addenda in EVIDENCE-AUDIT-2026-10-05.md. Image spread (owner's request, 20 October 2026): teaching slide 05 now shows the ContiClassic manufacturer figure (recoloured onto charcoal at build time) with the caption "Rigicon ContiClassic, manufacturer illustration"; slide 15 shows the annotated three-panel narrowing schematic made on 5 October (title band and footer cropped at build time, caption "Teaching schematic, not to scale"); slide 29 in the standard deck shows the UroOps balloon-pocket still (assets/uroops-balloon.png). The exploded and sagittal UroOps stills are no longer placed. Slide text unchanged. Owner's request, 20 October 2026: a traditional medical presentation, so the act framing and all on-slide timings were removed. The six dividers are plain section slides (title, one-line question, "In this section" outline, section strip); each teaching slide's header shows the section name and slide number only (no running clock); the cover eyebrow no longer states 60 minutes; the discussion slide lost its "five minutes" badge; the UroOps slide badge reads "Live demonstration"; backup and reference eyebrows read "Backup" and "References". Rehearsal timings remain in the presenter script only. Act V divider now carries a licensed Envato Elements photograph (surgical light, winnievinzence GM295KD) full-bleed under a charcoal veil with a left-to-right gradient; the file lives in the git-ignored presentation/assets/envato/ and is fitted to 4K by design/envato_fit.py at build time. The other five dividers are unchanged plain charcoal. No slide changed. At the owner's request (20 October 2026) the speaker notes were removed from the slides: the script is kept as a separate PDF, presenter-guide/AUS-presenter-script.pdf, and is not linked from the slides. Only the picture, clip and IFU-illustration credits remain in the notes pane of the image slides. The script itself was rewritten for the day: per slide THIS SLIDE WANTS, ON THE SLIDE, SAY (unchanged 10 October text), EXAMPLE (one concrete fictional example of the ask), STUDIES ON THIS SLIDE: WHAT EACH ONE DOES HERE (every footer code with the source, what it is, and how it supports this slide, with its limit) and NEXT. Text in presentation/design/support.mjs; DECK_NOTES=1 with build.mjs puts the script back into the notes if ever wanted.
